project_info.color_palette: Off-white, black, Cheetos orange, Nike neon green, Oreo blue, Sprite lime

main_subject.detail: A 2 by 2 square grid of premium minimalist brand print ads: Cheetos powder becomes a smiling cheese puff cloud, Nike shoe is wrapped in neon energy, Oreo opens into a cloud dream, and Sprite bottle is filled with lime slices.
main_subject.style: Surreal photoreal print advertising with oversized negative space

composition_elements.text: Pure Cheese.; LIGHT IT UP.; DREAM BIG; QUENCH REALITY
items: Upper left: Cheetos logo, cheese puff and orange powder face on white.
Upper right: Nike swoosh, green running shoe, luminous green energy on black.
Lower left: Oreo logo, opening cookie and cloud cream on pale gray.
Lower right: Sprite logo, lime-filled bottle on a white plinth.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Soft contact shadows, crisp product edges, controlled surreal material detail

assets.name: official brand logo
assets.usage: Use the exact vector mark with correct proportions, never a generated wordmark.

assets.name: hero product reference
assets.usage: Preserve product silhouette and brand identity.

prompt_instructions: Attach the official logo and hero product reference for the selected brand.
Create one hero metaphor plus one accent only; retain abundant negative space.
Treat the two-word slogan as brand-approved text, not improvised copy.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a surreal minimalist photoreal print-ad using the INPUT only. Auto-detect the brand from the INPUT and add the brand’s REAL official logo (not a generic wordmark), high fidelity, correct proportions, clean vector/print look, placed top-left with subtle ink-like texture. Use one bold visual metaphor, 1 hero + 1 accent max, huge negative space, studio lighting, 8K ultra-sharp, premium print-ad composition. Add a two-word slogan bottom-right that matches the brand tone. No clutter, no watermark, no extra text. Aspect ratio 1:1
prompt.negative_prompt: generic logo, altered packaging, clutter, multiple metaphors, extra text, weak negative space, low resolution, watermark
